source: Memory_Tech_Comparison.xlsx plus SCOPE v3-v7 equations and 2024-2025 OSFET BTI measurements

semantics.osfet_bti: Vth,max=70 mV defines equivalent retention. A 2024 VLSI ITO:F measurement anchors Delta-Vth at 18 mV after 1 ks, while a 2025 oxide-TFT stretched-exponential fit supplies beta and tau. The resulting periodic row read+write maintenance contributes both bandwidth occupancy and refresh power.
semantics.bti_scope: Cross-device behavior-level projection under conservative continuous DC stress; not a direct lifetime claim for one fabricated OSFET-eDRAM macro.

refresh.maintenance_action: row read followed by rewrite/recovery before Delta-Vth reaches 70 mV
